response.justification: Bogdan possesses valuable geospatial domain expertise through 8+ years developing GISCollective and contributing to OpenGreenMap, plus solid distributed systems and Linux knowledge. However, he has a critical gap: a 10-year hiatus from professional C++ development (last used 2014-2015) with no Rust experience, while the role requires modern C++ as its primary skill. His recent 7+ years focused on TypeScript/web development rather than systems programming. Interview worth considering only if assessing his motivation and feasibility to rapidly re-engage with modern systems programming.
strengths: Deep geospatial domain expertise through 8+ years with GISCollective and OpenGreenMap, including FOSS4G presentations and production GIS applications
Solid foundation in distributed systems, microservices infrastructure, asynchronous I/O, Linux administration, and systems-level thinking
Demonstrated full-stack engineer mindset with proven ability and willingness to learn across diverse technology domains
concerns: Modern C++ skills significantly outdated with 10-year gap since last professional C++ work (2014-2015 at National Instruments)
No Rust experience despite Rust being the acceptable alternative to C++ for this role
Recent 7+ years of career focused on TypeScript, Node.js, and web/product development rather than systems or pipeline programming

key_factors.factor: 10-year gap in C++ with no Rust alternative
Rare geospatial domain and GIS expertise
